question.text: Which of the following must be submitted to SEBI by a PM on quarterly basis?

explanation.text: The Logic: Quarterly AUM, performance, NAV, client numbers — standard SEBI reports. Ads are filed for advertising approval only when explicitly applicable. The Trap: Internal memos and birthdays are not reportable. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-B depth. Manager's Pro-Tip: Use SEBI's SCORES platform and PMS quarterly format to avoid penalties for late/incorrect filing.
